summary: ParseCommandEvidence now requires a single recognized invocation: runners are matched on token boundaries, compound shell lists/pipelines/substitutions/control operators stay unknown, explicit nonzero exits win, and an unrecorded exit is only resolved by a complete result line (standalone zero-exit line, clean pytest summary, go ok/PASS markers). A bare "0 failed" proves neither outcome. The Codex rollout adapter no longer splits compound commands, so no invocation inherits a shared exit status. Six-part migration entry added (docs/MIGRATION.md#changed-receipt-evidence-token-boundary).
